**Finding: deviation** (Section 19, ¶p0133)

Section 19 binds Sparkling with a **no-hire**, not a non-solicit — it bars each party and its affiliates from *hiring* "any employee of the other party." The "directly involved in the provision of services" limitation only qualifies the former-employee limb, so as to current employees the restriction sweeps in all of Garman's personnel, and there is no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. Both a no-hire and an all-personnel scope are walk-away items under NOSOLICIT, so the clause fails the fallback notwithstanding its acceptable one-year duration.

The validated redline (ok:true) moves the clause to the fallback position, consistent with approved precedent seed-nosolicit: mutual, solicitation-only, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, twelve months from the end of that involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and an express statement that hiring is not prohibited.
